title: 揭示视觉语言模型的可解释故障模式
summary: 提出REVELIO框架，系统性地发现VLM中的可解释故障模式。通过多样性波束搜索和高斯过程汤普森采样，在自动驾驶和室内机器人领域发现了先前未报告的漏洞，为提升VLM安全性提供可操作见解。
summary_en: Introduces REVELIO, a framework for systematically uncovering interpretable failure modes in VLMs. Using diversity-aware beam search and Gaussian-process Thompson Sampling, it reveals previously unreported vulnerabilities in autonomous driving and indoor robotics, offering actionable insights for VLM safety improvements.
